_comment: Managed npm tools (audit B5). Exact versions and the registry's sha512 integrity of each package tarball; installManaged refuses any other bytes. Installs run with --ignore-scripts; scripts:true tools run only their own install scripts (npm rebuild) after the integrity check. Bump version and integrity together: npm view <package>@<version> dist.integrity.

netlify-cli.note: Works without scripts (verified: netlify --version 23.15.1 after --ignore-scripts); its postinstall only prints a welcome and sets up shell completion. Ships npm-shrinkwrap.json, so its dependency tree is pinned too.

wrangler.note: esbuild and workerd come as per-platform optional dependencies; their install scripts only re-check those binaries.

claude-code.note: Needs its postinstall (install.cjs): it puts the native claude binary in place of the bin/claude.exe stub; without it `claude --version` fails. Only this package's own script runs, after the integrity check.
